env GO111MODULE=on

# A zip carrying an alias-extension file is rejected through a local
# file proxy with no network, while a zip carrying the canonical .lgo
# spelling of the same module downloads. The rejection names the alias
# file, so it comes from the module zip validation and not the network.
# The proxy settings stay on the download commands so the network
# section below keeps the harness proxy.
go run genzip.go $WORK/proxy
exec env GOPROXY=file://$WORK/proxy GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go mod download example.com/lgomod@v1.0.0
! exec env GOPROXY=file://$WORK/proxy GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go mod download example.com/aliasmod@v1.0.0
stderr 'x\.📜'

! go get rsc.io/badlogos@v1.0.0
stderr 'badlogos.*malformed file path "x.📜": invalid char'
stderr 'badlogos.*malformed file path "x.⚡": invalid char'
stderr 'badlogos.*malformed file path "x.ʕ◔ϖ◔ʔ": invalid char'


-- go.mod --
module example.com/zipalias

go 1.27

-- genzip.go --
// Copyright 2026 The Go Authors. All rights reserved.
// Use of this source code is governed by a BSD-style
// license that can be found in the LICENSE file.

package main

import (
	"archive/zip"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func writeFile(path, body string) {
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(body), 0o666); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func writeModule(proxy, path, version, name, body string) {
	dir := filepath.Join(proxy, path, "@v")
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o777); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	writeFile(filepath.Join(dir, version+".info"), `{"Version":"`+version+`"}`)
	mod := "module " + path + "\n\ngo 1.27\n"
	writeFile(filepath.Join(dir, version+".mod"), mod)
	zf, err := os.Create(filepath.Join(dir, version+".zip"))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	w := zip.NewWriter(zf)
	add := func(entry, content string) {
		f, err := w.Create(entry)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
		if _, err := f.Write([]byte(content)); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	add(path+"@"+version+"/"+name, body)
	add(path+"@"+version+"/go.mod", mod)
	if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if err := zf.Close(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("wrote", path, version)
}

func main() {
	proxy := os.Args[1]
	writeModule(proxy, "example.com/aliasmod", "v1.0.0", "x.📜", "package aliasmod\n")
	writeModule(proxy, "example.com/lgomod", "v1.0.0", "x.lgo", "package lgomod\n")
}
